text: 8月30日，2026年国家社科基金年度项目评审工作会议在京召开。中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并讲话。 会议指出，习近平总书记关于推动哲学社会科学高质量发展的重要指示，为新征程上推动哲学社会科学繁荣发展提供了根本遵循、提出了明确要求。哲学社会科学界要以习近平总书记重要指示精神为指引，深入学习习近平文化思想，深刻把握推动哲学社会科学发展的指导思想、根本保证和目标任务，全面推进各学科建设、各领域研究、各方面工作，以哲学社会科学高质量发展新成效服务强国建设、民族复兴伟业。 会议强调，中国式现代化为哲学社会科学高质量发展提供了丰富的实践基础和广阔的创新
text_en: On August 30, the 2026 National Social Science Fund annual project review meeting was held in Beijing. Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended and spoke. The meeting noted that General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on advancing high-quality development of philosophy and social sciences provide fundamental guidance and clear requirements for promoting the prosperity of philosophy and social sciences on the new journey. The philosophy and social sciences community should follow Xi's important instructions, deeply study Xi Jinping's cultural thought, and grasp the guiding principles, fundamental guarantees, and goals of developing philosophy and social sciences, comprehensively advancing discipline building, research, and all aspects of work to serve the cause of building a strong nation and national rejuvenation with new achievements in high-quality development.
